_comment: Written by scripts/pipedrive_create_fields.mjs. status=placeholder means the script has NOT been run against a real Pipedrive account yet: the `key` values below are deterministic stand-ins so that CONFIG, the fixtures and the static tests are all wired up and testable offline. A real run replaces every `key` with the 40-hex field key Pipedrive returns and every option `id` with the real option id, and sets status=live. Nothing else in the repo needs to change: CONFIG is regenerated from this file (npm run gen:config).

icp_calculated.name: ICP Calculated
icp_calculated.purpose: The system's answer. Written by WF-ICP-Score only.

icp_score.name: ICP Score
icp_score.purpose: final_score, 0-100. Empty when status is insufficient_data or Error.

icp_scored_at.name: ICP Scored At
icp_scored_at.purpose: When the score was written. Drives the 180-day re-score gate.

icp_model_version.name: ICP Model Version
icp_model_version.purpose: Rubric version the score came from. A different version forces a re-score.

icp_final.name: ICP Final
icp_final.purpose: HUMAN-OWNED. Created so reps have somewhere to record an override. INVARIANT: never read as scoring input, never written by any workflow. See tests/static/nodes_execute.test.mjs 'never touches Final'.

auto_icp_score.name: Auto-ICP Score
auto_icp_score.purpose: The ONLY organization field this workflow writes. Text, formatted "<final> - <grade>", e.g. "56 - B"; "n/a - insufficient data" when the score could not be produced. Text rather than a number and an enum because it is one human-readable fact, and two fields that can disagree about the same run is a worse shape than one that cannot.

sales_rep_icp_score.name: Sales Rep ICP Score
sales_rep_icp_score.purpose: The human's field. Created by this repo so it exists next to the automatic one, and NEVER written to — asserted in BuildOrgPatch and in the static suite, not merely omitted.
